1	# State of the Web 2020–2025: HTTP Archive Trends
     2	
     3	## Source
     4	
     5	HTTP Archive — State of the Web Report  
     6	https://httparchive.org/reports/state-of-the-web?start=2020_01_01&end=latest&view=list
     7	
     8	## Overview
     9	
    10	The HTTP Archive continuously crawls millions of URLs and records how the web is built. The "State of the Web" report tracks macro-level metrics including page weight, request counts, protocol adoption (HTTPS, HTTP/2, HTTP/3), TCP connection counts, and CSS best-practice adoption such as `font-display`. The data below covers January 2020 through early 2026, with desktop and mobile measured separately.
    11	
    12	## Sample Size
    13	
    14	The crawl sample has grown substantially. In January 2020 the desktop crawl covered roughly 5 million URLs and mobile roughly 3.5 million. By mid-2022 both lines jumped sharply — desktop reaching ~15 million and mobile ~10 million — before stabilizing around 16 million (desktop) and 12.5 million (mobile) by mid-2023 onward.
    15	
    16	![Timeseries of Sample Size — Desktop vs Mobile](./assets/figure_1.jpg)
    17	
    18	## Page Weight & Requests
    19	
    20	Median total transfer size has risen gradually over five years. Desktop pages now weigh approximately 2,000 KB (median), up from ~1,600 KB in early 2020. Mobile pages track slightly lower but follow the same upward trend. The 75th-percentile desktop page exceeds 4,000 KB, indicating a long tail of heavy pages.
    21	
    22	![Timeseries of Total Kilobytes — Desktop vs Mobile with IQR bands](./assets/figure_2.jpg)
    23	
    24	The median number of resources requested per page is 76 on desktop and 71 on mobile, each up roughly 3% over the observation period.
    25	
    26	| Metric | Desktop | Mobile | Desktop Δ | Mobile Δ |
    27	|---|---|---|---|---|
    28	| Total Kilobytes (median) | ~2,000 KB | ~1,900 KB | ▲ ~25% | ▲ ~25% |
    29	| Total Requests (median) | 76 | 71 | ▲ 2.7% | ▲ 2.9% |
    30	| TCP Connections / Page (median) | 12.0 | 11.0 | ▼ 14.3% | ▼ 26.7% |
    31	
    32	## TCP Connections Per Page
    33	
    34	Despite growing request counts, the median number of TCP connections per page has fallen — from about 15 (desktop) and 15 (mobile) in early 2020 to 12 and 11 respectively. This decline reflects the multiplexing benefits of HTTP/2 and HTTP/3, which allow many requests over fewer connections.
    35	
    36	![Timeseries of TCP Connections Per Page](./assets/figure_3.jpg)
    37	
    38	## Protocol & Security Adoption
    39	
    40	### HTTPS
    41	
    42	HTTPS adoption is now effectively universal. 99.2% of desktop requests and 99.1% of mobile requests use HTTPS, representing an increase of roughly 19–20 percentage points since early 2020 when adoption was around 80%.
    43	
    44	### HTTP/2
    45	
    46	HTTP/2 accounts for 58.6% of desktop requests and 57.6% of mobile requests. Growth has been modest recently (1–3%), partly because HTTP/3 is absorbing some of the newer adoption.
    47	
    48	### HTTP/3 Support
    49	
    50	HTTP/3 support has seen explosive growth. Desktop support stands at 38.7% and mobile at 40.0%. The percentage increases from the 2020 baseline are enormous (reported as 38,600% desktop and 5,614% mobile) because the starting point was near zero. Note: HTTP Archive measures HTTP/3 *support* rather than actual usage because fresh Chrome instances default to HTTP/2 on first connection before discovering HTTP/3 capability via Alt-Svc headers.
    51	
    52	| Protocol Metric | Desktop | Mobile |
    53	|---|---|---|
    54	| HTTPS Requests | 99.2% | 99.1% |
    55	| HTTP/2 Requests | 58.6% | 57.6% |
    56	| HTTP/3 Support | 38.7% | 40.0% |
    57	
    58	## Font-Display Adoption
    59	
    60	The `font-display` CSS property helps avoid the Flash of Invisible Text (FOIT) during web font loading. As measured by Lighthouse, 40.1% of desktop pages and 42.5% of mobile pages now use this property — up 14.9% and 61.0% respectively since 2020. While adoption is growing, more than half of pages still risk FOIT.
    61	
    62	## Key Findings
    63	
    64	- **Page weight keeps climbing**: Median desktop pages now transfer ~2,000 KB, roughly 25% heavier than in 2020, driven by richer media and JavaScript.
    65	- **HTTPS is the new baseline**: At 99%+ of requests, unencrypted HTTP is essentially extinct on the modern web.
    66	- **HTTP/3 is the fastest-growing protocol metric**: From near-zero to ~40% support in under four years, HTTP/3 is rapidly becoming mainstream.
    67	- **Fewer TCP connections despite more requests**: Multiplexing in HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 has cut median connections per page by 15–27%, improving network efficiency.
    68	- **Font-display still underused**: At ~40–42% adoption, there is significant room for improvement in avoiding invisible text during font loading.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the 8-slide HTTP Archive State of the Web 2020–2025 presentation."""

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE
from pptx.oxml.ns import qn
from pptx.oxml import parse_xml
import os

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Constants
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
SLIDE_WIDTH = Inches(13.333)
SLIDE_HEIGHT = Inches(7.5)

# Color palette — dark, analytical, data-forward
COLOR_BG = RGBColor(0x0F, 0x14, 0x1A)          # near-black slate
COLOR_ACCENT = RGBColor(0x00, 0xC8, 0xFF)      # cyan
COLOR_ACCENT2 = RGBColor(0xFF, 0x6B, 0x35)     # warm orange
COLOR_TEXT = RGBColor(0xE8, 0xEB, 0xF0)        # off-white
COLOR_TEXT_DIM = RGBColor(0x8A, 0x93, 0x9E)    # muted grey
COLOR_CARD_BG = RGBColor(0x1A, 0x22, 0x2E)     # card background
COLOR_GRID = RGBColor(0x2A, 0x35, 0x45)        # subtle grid/border

ASSETS_DIR = "/app/benchmark/assets"
OUTPUT_PATH = "/app/output/final_deck.pptx"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def set_slide_bg(slide, color):
    """Set solid background color for a slide."""
    background = slide.background
    fill = background.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color


def add_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size, font_color,
                bold=False, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, font_name="Segoe UI"):
    """Add a text box with specified formatting."""
    tf = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height).text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = font_size
    p.font.color.rgb = font_color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.alignment = align
    return tf


def add_shape_text(slide, shape_type, left, top, width, height, text,
                   font_size, font_color, bold=False, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT,
                   fill_color=None, line_color=None, font_name="Segoe UI"):
    """Add a shape with text inside."""
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(shape_type, left, top, width, height)
    if fill_color:
        shape.fill.solid()
        shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    else:
        shape.fill.background()
    if line_color:
        shape.line.color.rgb = line_color
        shape.line.width = Pt(1)
    else:
        shape.line.fill.background()
    tf = shape.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = font_size
    p.font.color.rgb = font_color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.alignment = align
    return shape


def add_line(slide, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, width=Pt(1)):
    """Add a straight line."""
    connector = slide.shapes.add_connector(
        MSO_SHAPE.STRAIGHT_CONNECTOR_1, x1, y1, x2, y2
    )
    connector.line.color.rgb = color
    connector.line.width = width
    return connector


def add_bullet_text(slide, left, top, width, height, bullets,
                    font_size, font_color, bullet_color=None, font_name="Segoe UI"):
    """Add a text frame with multiple bullet paragraphs."""
    tf = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height).text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, txt in enumerate(bullets):
        if i == 0:
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        p.text = txt
        p.font.size = font_size
        p.font.color.rgb = font_color
        p.font.name = font_name
        p.level = 0
        p.space_after = Pt(10)
        if bullet_color:
            p.font.color.rgb = bullet_color
    return tf


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Slide builders
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def build_title_slide(prs):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])  # blank
    set_slide_bg(slide, COLOR_BG)

    # Accent top bar
    add_shape_text(slide, MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, Inches(0), Inches(0),
                   Inches(13.333), Inches(0.08), "",
                   Pt(1), COLOR_TEXT, fill_color=COLOR_ACCENT)

    # Title
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(2.2), Inches(11.7), Inches(1.4),
                "State of the Web 2020–2025",
                Pt(48), COLOR_TEXT, bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

    # Subtitle
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(3.5), Inches(11.7), Inches(0.8),
                "Tracking Page Weight, Protocols & Security at Scale",
                Pt(28), COLOR_ACCENT, bold=False, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

    # Meta info
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(4.5), Inches(11.7), Inches(0.6),
                "Data Source: HTTP Archive  •  Jan 2020 – Mar 2026",
                Pt(16), COLOR_TEXT_DIM, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

    # Audience tag
    add_shape_text(slide, MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE,
                   Inches(0.8), Inches(5.3), Inches(5.5), Inches(0.5),
                   "Audience: Web Performance Engineers & Front-End Architects",
                   Pt(12), COLOR_TEXT_DIM, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT,
                   fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG, line_color=COLOR_GRID)

    return slide


def build_sample_size_slide(prs):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    set_slide_bg(slide, COLOR_BG)

    # Title
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.4), Inches(12), Inches(0.8),
                "Crawl Sample Size Tripled: From ~5M to 16M Desktop URLs Since 2020",
                Pt(28), COLOR_TEXT, bold=True)

    # Subtitle / context
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.1), Inches(12), Inches(0.5),
                "HTTP Archive continuously crawls millions of URLs; the sample expanded sharply in mid-2022 and has plateaued since mid-2023.",
                Pt(14), COLOR_TEXT_DIM)

    # Chart image (figure_1)
    img_path = os.path.join(ASSETS_DIR, "figure_1.jpg")
    slide.shapes.add_picture(img_path, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.7), width=Inches(9.5))

    # Right-side stat cards
    card_w = Inches(2.8)
    card_h = Inches(1.1)
    card_x = Inches(10.4)

    # Desktop card
    add_shape_text(slide, MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE,
                   card_x, Inches(1.9), card_w, card_h,
                   "Desktop\n~16M URLs", Pt(18), COLOR_TEXT,
                   bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER,
                   fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG, line_color=COLOR_GRID)

    # Mobile card
    add_shape_text(slide, MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE,
                   card_x, Inches(3.2), card_w, card_h,
                   "Mobile\n~12.5M URLs", Pt(18), COLOR_TEXT,
                   bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER,
                   fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG, line_color=COLOR_GRID)

    # Jump annotation
    add_shape_text(slide, MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE,
                   card_x, Inches(4.5), card_w, Inches(0.9),
                   "Sharp jump\nmid-2022", Pt(14), COLOR_ACCENT2,
                   bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER,
                   fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG, line_color=COLOR_ACCENT2)

    # Source note
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(6.8), Inches(12), Inches(0.4),
                "Source: HTTP Archive – State of the Web Report",
                Pt(10), COLOR_TEXT_DIM)

    return slide


def build_page_weight_slide(prs):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    set_slide_bg(slide, COLOR_BG)

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.4), Inches(12), Inches(0.8),
                "Median Page Weight Climbs Steadily to ~2,000 KB on Desktop",
                Pt(28), COLOR_TEXT, bold=True)

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.1), Inches(12), Inches(0.5),
                "Total transfer size has risen ~25% over five years; mobile tracks slightly below desktop with a similarly heavy tail.",
                Pt(14), COLOR_TEXT_DIM)

    img_path = os.path.join(ASSETS_DIR, "figure_2.jpg")
    slide.shapes.add_picture(img_path, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.7), width=Inches(9.5))

    # Stat cards on right
    card_w = Inches(2.8)
    card_x = Inches(10.4)

    add_shape_text(slide, MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE,
                   card_x, Inches(1.9), card_w, Inches(1.0),
                   "Desktop Median\n~2,000 KB", Pt(18), COLOR_TEXT,
                   bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER,
                   fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG, line_color=COLOR_GRID)

    add_shape_text(slide, MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE,
                   card_x, Inches(3.1), card_w, Inches(1.0),
                   "Mobile Median\n~1,900 KB", Pt(18), COLOR_TEXT,
                   bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER,
                   fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG, line_color=COLOR_GRID)

    add_shape_text(slide, MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE,
                   card_x, Inches(4.3), card_w, Inches(1.0),
                   "75th Percentile\n> 4,000 KB", Pt(18), COLOR_ACCENT2,
                   bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER,
                   fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG, line_color=COLOR_ACCENT2)

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(6.8), Inches(12), Inches(0.4),
                "Source: HTTP Archive – State of the Web Report",
                Pt(10), COLOR_TEXT_DIM)

    return slide


def build_requests_connections_slide(prs):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    set_slide_bg(slide, COLOR_BG)

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.4), Inches(12), Inches(0.8),
                "76 Requests per Desktop Page While TCP Connections Drop to 12",
                Pt(28), COLOR_TEXT, bold=True)

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.1), Inches(12), Inches(0.5),
                "Request counts edge up ~3%, but multiplexing in HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 drives a 15–27% decline in TCP connections per page.",
                Pt(14), COLOR_TEXT_DIM)

    # Left: stat cards for requests
    left_x = Inches(0.6)
    card_w = Inches(3.8)

    add_shape_text(slide, MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE,
                   left_x, Inches(1.9), card_w, Inches(1.2),
                   "Desktop Requests\n76  ▲ 2.7%", Pt(22), COLOR_TEXT,
                   bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER,
                   fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG, line_color=COLOR_GRID)

    add_shape_text(slide, MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE,
                   left_x, Inches(3.3), card_w, Inches(1.2),
                   "Mobile Requests\n71  ▲ 2.9%", Pt(22), COLOR_TEXT,
                   bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER,
                   fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG, line_color=COLOR_GRID)

    # Right: TCP connections chart
    img_path = os.path.join(ASSETS_DIR, "figure_3.jpg")
    slide.shapes.add_picture(img_path, Inches(4.8), Inches(1.7), width=Inches(8.0))

    # Bottom annotation line
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(6.4), Inches(12), Inches(0.4),
                "Efficiency insight: fewer handshakes and better multiplexing mean less connection overhead despite richer pages.",
                Pt(12), COLOR_ACCENT)

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(6.8), Inches(12), Inches(0.4),
                "Source: HTTP Archive – State of the Web Report",
                Pt(10), COLOR_TEXT_DIM)

    return slide


def build_https_slide(prs):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    set_slide_bg(slide, COLOR_BG)

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.4), Inches(12), Inches(0.8),
                "HTTPS Requests Reach 99%: Encryption Is Now the Default",
                Pt(28), COLOR_TEXT, bold=True)

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.1), Inches(12), Inches(0.5),
                "Unencrypted HTTP is effectively extinct on the modern web after a ~19–20 percentage-point climb since 2020.",
                Pt(14), COLOR_TEXT_DIM)

    # Large stat callout
    add_shape_text(slide, MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE,
                   Inches(0.6), Inches(1.9), Inches(5.5), Inches(2.4),
                   "99%+", Pt(72), COLOR_ACCENT,
                   bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER,
                   fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG, line_color=COLOR_ACCENT)

    # Sub-stats under callout
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(4.4), Inches(5.5), Inches(0.5),
                "Desktop: 99.2%  •  Mobile: 99.1%",
                Pt(18), COLOR_TEXT, bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(4.9), Inches(5.5), Inches(0.5),
                "Up from ~80% in early 2020",
                Pt(14), COLOR_TEXT_DIM, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

    # Right: small time-series representation (we'll draw a conceptual line)
    right_x = Inches(6.8)
    # Container box
    add_shape_text(slide, MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE,
                   right_x, Inches(1.9), Inches(5.8), Inches(3.2),
                   "", Pt(1), COLOR_TEXT,
                   fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG, line_color=COLOR_GRID)

    add_textbox(slide, right_x + Inches(0.3), Inches(2.1), Inches(5.2), Inches(0.4),
                "HTTPS Adoption Trajectory",
                Pt(16), COLOR_TEXT, bold=True)

    # Draw a conceptual rising line with points
    # Coordinates inside the right panel
    base_x = right_x + Inches(0.5)
    base_y = Inches(4.6)
    end_x = right_x + Inches(5.3)
    end_y = Inches(2.6)

    # Line
    add_line(slide, base_x, base_y, end_x, end_y, COLOR_ACCENT, Pt(3))

    # Data points
    for frac, label, val in [(0.0, "2020", "~80%"), (0.5, "2022", "~93%"), (1.0, "2026", "99%+")]:
        px = base_x + (end_x - base_x) * frac
        py = base_y + (end_y - base_y) * frac
        # dot
        dot = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.OVAL, px - Inches(0.08), py - Inches(0.08),
                                     Inches(0.16), Inches(0.16))
        dot.fill.solid()
        dot.fill.fore_color.rgb = COLOR_ACCENT
        dot.line.fill.background()
        # label
        add_textbox(slide, px - Inches(0.4), py + Inches(0.15), Inches(0.8), Inches(0.3),
                    label, Pt(10), COLOR_TEXT_DIM, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
        add_textbox(slide, px - Inches(0.4), py - Inches(0.35), Inches(0.8), Inches(0.3),
                    val, Pt(12), COLOR_TEXT, bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(6.8), Inches(12), Inches(0.4),
                "Source: HTTP Archive – State of the Web Report",
                Pt(10), COLOR_TEXT_DIM)

    return slide


def build_http2_http3_slide(prs):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    set_slide_bg(slide, COLOR_BG)

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.4), Inches(12), Inches(0.8),
                "HTTP/2 Holds at ~58% While HTTP/3 Support Surges to 40%",
                Pt(28), COLOR_TEXT, bold=True)

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.1), Inches(12), Inches(0.5),
                "HTTP/2 growth has flattened as HTTP/3 rapidly becomes mainstream. Note: HTTP/3 support is measured, not first-request usage.",
                Pt(14), COLOR_TEXT_DIM)

    # Grouped bar chart representation (4 bars)
    bar_area_x = Inches(0.6)
    bar_area_y = Inches(1.9)
    bar_area_w = Inches(7.5)
    bar_area_h = Inches(3.6)

    # Background
    add_shape_text(slide, MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE,
                   bar_area_x, bar_area_y, bar_area_w, bar_area_h,
                   "", Pt(1), COLOR_TEXT,
                   fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG, line_color=COLOR_GRID)

    add_textbox(slide, bar_area_x + Inches(0.3), bar_area_y + Inches(0.15), Inches(4), Inches(0.4),
                "Protocol Adoption Snapshot (% of requests / support)",
                Pt(14), COLOR_TEXT, bold=True)

    # Bars: Desktop HTTP/2, Mobile HTTP/2, Desktop HTTP/3, Mobile HTTP/3
    bar_data = [
        ("HTTP/2\nDesktop", 58.6, COLOR_ACCENT),
        ("HTTP/2\nMobile", 57.6, COLOR_ACCENT),
        ("HTTP/3\nDesktop", 38.7, COLOR_ACCENT2),
        ("HTTP/3\nMobile", 40.0, COLOR_ACCENT2),
    ]

    bar_w = Inches(1.1)
    gap = Inches(0.4)
    start_x = bar_area_x + Inches(0.6)
    max_h = Inches(2.6)
    base_y = bar_area_y + Inches(3.0)

    for i, (label, pct, color) in enumerate(bar_data):
        bx = start_x + i * (bar_w + gap)
        bh = max_h * (pct / 100.0)
        by = base_y - bh
        bar = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, bx, by, bar_w, bh)
        bar.fill.solid()
        bar.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
        bar.line.fill.background()
        # Label below
        add_textbox(slide, bx - Inches(0.1), base_y + Inches(0.05), bar_w + Inches(0.2), Inches(0.5),
                    label, Pt(11), COLOR_TEXT_DIM, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
        # Value on top
        add_textbox(slide, bx - Inches(0.1), by - Inches(0.3), bar_w + Inches(0.2), Inches(0.3),
                    f"{pct}%", Pt(13), COLOR_TEXT, bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

    # Right panel: HTTP/3 growth stats
    right_x = Inches(8.5)
    add_shape_text(slide, MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE,
                   right_x, Inches(1.9), Inches(4.0), Inches(1.4),
                   "HTTP/3 Desktop\n+38,600%", Pt(20), COLOR_ACCENT2,
                   bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER,
                   fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG, line_color=COLOR_ACCENT2)

    add_shape_text(slide, MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE,
                   right_x, Inches(3.5), Inches(4.0), Inches(1.4),
                   "HTTP/3 Mobile\n+5,614%", Pt(20), COLOR_ACCENT2,
                   bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER,
                   fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG, line_color=COLOR_ACCENT2)

    add_textbox(slide, right_x, Inches(5.1), Inches(4.0), Inches(0.8),
                "From near-zero baselines in 2020; enormous relative growth reflects early-stage adoption.",
                Pt(12), COLOR_TEXT_DIM, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(6.8), Inches(12), Inches(0.4),
                "Source: HTTP Archive – State of the Web Report",
                Pt(10), COLOR_TEXT_DIM)

    return slide


def build_font_display_slide(prs):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    set_slide_bg(slide, COLOR_BG)

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.4), Inches(12), Inches(0.8),
                "Font-Display Usage Reaches 42% on Mobile, Up 61% Since 2020",
                Pt(28), COLOR_TEXT, bold=True)

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.1), Inches(12), Inches(0.5),
                "The font-display CSS property mitigates Flash of Invisible Text (FOIT). Adoption is rising, yet the majority of pages still risk invisible text.",
                Pt(14), COLOR_TEXT_DIM)

    # Two large stat callouts side by side
    add_shape_text(slide, MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE,
                   Inches(0.6), Inches(1.9), Inches(5.5), Inches(2.0),
                   "Desktop\n40.1%", Pt(40), COLOR_ACCENT,
                   bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER,
                   fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG, line_color=COLOR_ACCENT)

    add_shape_text(slide, MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE,
                   Inches(6.8), Inches(1.9), Inches(5.5), Inches(2.0),
                   "Mobile\n42.5%", Pt(40), COLOR_ACCENT2,
                   bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER,
                   fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG, line_color=COLOR_ACCENT2)

    # Growth labels under each
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(4.0), Inches(5.5), Inches(0.4),
                "▲ 14.9% since 2020", Pt(16), COLOR_TEXT, bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(6.8), Inches(4.0), Inches(5.5), Inches(0.4),
                "▲ 61.0% since 2020", Pt(16), COLOR_TEXT, bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

    # Insight box
    add_shape_text(slide, MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE,
                   Inches(0.6), Inches(4.7), Inches(11.7), Inches(0.9),
                   "Insight: With ~58–60% of pages still not using font-display, there is significant headroom for improving perceived font-loading performance.",
                   Pt(14), COLOR_TEXT_DIM, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT,
                   fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG, line_color=COLOR_GRID)

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(6.8), Inches(12), Inches(0.4),
                "Source: HTTP Archive – State of the Web Report (Lighthouse audit data)",
                Pt(10), COLOR_TEXT_DIM)

    return slide


def build_takeaways_slide(prs):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    set_slide_bg(slide, COLOR_BG)

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.4), Inches(12), Inches(0.8),
                "Key Takeaways: Bigger Pages, Smarter Protocols, Stronger Security",
                Pt(28), COLOR_TEXT, bold=True)

    bullets = [
        "1. Page weight keeps climbing — Median desktop pages now transfer ~2,000 KB, roughly 25% heavier than in 2020, driven by richer media and JavaScript.",
        "2. HTTPS is the new baseline — At 99%+ of requests, unencrypted HTTP is essentially extinct on the modern web.",
        "3. HTTP/3 is the fastest-growing protocol metric — From near-zero to ~40% support in under four years, HTTP/3 is rapidly becoming mainstream.",
        "4. Fewer TCP connections despite more requests — Multiplexing in HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 has cut median connections per page by 15–27%, improving network efficiency.",
        "5. Font-display still underused — At ~40–42% adoption, there is significant room for improvement in avoiding invisible text during font loading.",
    ]

    add_bullet_text(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.3), Inches(12), Inches(4.5),
                    bullets, Pt(16), COLOR_TEXT, font_name="Segoe UI")

    # CTA box
    add_shape_text(slide, MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE,
                   Inches(0.6), Inches(5.6), Inches(12), Inches(0.9),
                   "Call to Action: Benchmark your own sites against these HTTP Archive baselines and prioritize the highest-impact optimizations for your stack.",
                   Pt(16), COLOR_BG, bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER,
                   fill_color=COLOR_ACCENT, line_color=COLOR_ACCENT)

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(6.8), Inches(12), Inches(0.4),
                "Source: HTTP Archive – State of the Web Report  •  Jan 2020 – Mar 2026",
                Pt(10), COLOR_TEXT_DIM)

    return slide


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main():
    prs = Presentation()
    prs.slide_width = SLIDE_WIDTH
    prs.slide_height = SLIDE_HEIGHT

    build_title_slide(prs)
    build_sample_size_slide(prs)
    build_page_weight_slide(prs)
    build_requests_connections_slide(prs)
    build_https_slide(prs)
    build_http2_http3_slide(prs)
    build_font_display_slide(prs)
    build_takeaways_slide(prs)

    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUTPUT_PATH), exist_ok=True)
    prs.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
    print(f"Saved presentation to {OUTPUT_PATH}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
